Hadith.964 - Hisham ibn Salim said to Abu Abdullah (as):
"I go out and I love to be in a state of spiritual continuation (mu'aqqib)."
Imam (as) replied: "If you are in a state of ablution (wudhu), then you are considered to be in a state of spiritual continuation (mu'aqqib)."
